graphqlRelevantOperations.body:
query loadBlog(
  $categoryId: String
  $subCategoryId: String
  $released: Boolean
  $limit: Int
  $sort: String
  $sortOrder: String
  $tags: [String],
  $enableContentful: Boolean!
) {
  contentfulBlogs (categoryId: $subCategoryId, tags: $tags, limit: $limit, sort: $sort, sortOrder: $sortOrder) @include(if: $enableContentful) {
    title
    id
    visible
    introduction
    heroCaption
    imageSlug
    imageVariants
    author {
      id
      name
      image
    }
    added
    subCategoryId
    categoryId
    tags {
      value
      link
    }
  }
  games(
    categoryId: $categoryId
    subCategoryId: $subCategoryId
    released: $released
    limit: $limit
    sort: $sort
    tags: $tags
  ) @skip(if: $enableContentful) {
    title
    id
    visible
    labelText
    introduction
    heroCaption
    imageSlug
    authorName
    author {
      id
      name
      image
    }
    added
    subCategoryId
    categoryId
    tags {
      value
      link
    }
  }
}

query loadPageOrGame(
  $path: String,
  $released: Boolean,
  $variant: Int,
  $enableContentful: Boolean!,
  $resourceId: String,
  $categoryId: String,
  $isPage: Boolean!,
  $isGame: Boolean!,
  $isBlog: Boolean!
) {
  pageOrGame(path: $path, released: $released, variant: $variant) @skip(if: $enableContentful){
    page {
      title
      customTermsAndConditions
      path
      metaTags
      canonical
      components {
        type
        props
      }
